name: movie_mira_isi
label: Movie: Mira's diameter near maximum with the ISI line at 900 nm, three nights (the first intensity-interferometric size of a long-period variable)
notes: Baselines 2.5/3/5.5, 3/4/7 and 4/5/9 m: the first lobe, the 7.1 m null and the first sidelobe of a 32 mas disk at 900 nm. Mira sits just under the PDM's cap, so its S/N is its own: ~50 sigma per night, ~1.8 % on the diameter per night, ~1 % in three.

The diameter is phase-dependent (+/- 10 % over 332 d) and chromatic (the TiO-band disk at 650 nm ~40 % larger): the campaign is a snapshot near maximum; an optional 650 nm night would measure the molecular layer.
